topic: Coffee4U ₪15 צ'יטה שופס pickup-point alternative: locality coverage and rendered fee for the five selectable destinations on the tracked Crema e Gusto 250 g listing
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through scripts/browser-research.mjs (npm run research:browser), one live session kept across steps. The anonymous 2 × 250 g cart (₪76) was built by the checked-in coffee4u recipe (Tel Aviv - Yafo, door-to-door selected and confirmed) and then, in the same session, the checkout's own #delivery select was switched to its pickup-point option (value 2). Each selectable locality was chosen from the vendor's closed #u_city list; the pickup-point city select (#chita_cities), the per-city pickup-spot select (#chita_spots) and the rendered summary were read after each selection. No order, payment, login, account creation or street address was involved, and no bot challenge or access control was bypassed. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so no image-based visual claim is made. Every value below is backed by the rendered DOM/text captured in the same live session; the screenshot is an artifact for a human reviewer.

deliverySelect.pickupPointOption: משלוח לנקודת איסוף צ`יטה שופס (עד 7 ימי עסקים - עד 5 ק"ג 30*30*30) - 15 ₪
deliverySelect.doorToDoorOption: שליחות מדלת לדלת עד 1-5 ימי עסקים - 30 ₪ (value 3)

observations.localityList: The pickup-point service keeps its own closed locality select (#chita_cities, 427 options including the 'בחר עיר' placeholder = 426 localities, observed 2026-10-13; 420 were recorded on 2026-10-12). Selecting a main destination in #u_city syncs the pickup city select when that locality is on the pickup list; all five selectable destinations are on it.
observations.spots: Choosing the pickup-point method reveals 'בחר נקודת איסוף' (#chita_spots) with the pickup points for the selected locality; the fee (₪15) and total (₪91) are displayed without choosing a specific spot, which is required only before ordering.
observations.destinationBeyondList: A destination that is not on the 426-locality pickup list cannot use the ₪15 alternative; the checkout only offers its closed lists, and 'Elsewhere in Israel' is not a selectable locality.

conclusion: The published ₪15 pickup-point alternative is verified for all five selectable destinations: each is present in the vendor's pickup locality list, has pickup spots (4-34 depending on locality) and quotes ₪76 + ₪15 = ₪91 for the 500 g cart. The ranked door-to-door rate (₪30) is unchanged and remains the ranked amount; the pickup-point service stays a display-only alternative. The earlier 420-locality count is superseded by the 426 observed on 2026-10-13.
policyImpact: Provenance-only update to coffee4u-il-home-delivery v3: the money/scope (₪30 ranked, ₪15 alternative, 1,269-locality door-to-door list) is unchanged, so the read-time evaluator refreshes the coverage provenance on already-stamped persisted rows; no price/stock observation time or refresh marker is touched.
